source_documents.title: JPL UAVSAR POLSAR Data Format (related collection)

processing_chain: Two UAVSAR L-band data takes of one flight line -> JPL processor -> SLCs (internal; by request only)
Co-registration; AMP, INT (SLC1 x conj SLC2), COR, UNW (Goldstein/Werner); GRD by backward projection onto the DEM (SOURCE_DEM)
Downstream: ABoVE ReSALT subsidence/ALT (re-unwrapped interferometric phase); indexed by SnowEx UAVSAR

depth_2.note: There are no PARENT or PARENT-like collections. The JPL UAVSAR SLCs (and raw data) are not distributed as CMR collections. The only UAVSAR SLC collections in CMR are campaign stacks (Delta-X, Pre-Delta-X) that are siblings, not inputs. The DEM INPUTs have their own lineage (SRTM, ASTER), outside the target's (rule 1c-1). So no depth-2 rows are written.
